question: Which driver has the fastest lap time? Please give their forenames and surnames.
clarification: Ignore rows where fastestLapTime is missing.
gold: SELECT T2.forename, T2.surname, T1.fastestLapTime FROM results AS T1 INNER JOIN drivers AS T2 ON T1.driverId = T2.driverId ORDER BY T1.fastestLapTime ASC LIMIT 1
gold0: SELECT T2.forename, T2.surname, T1.fastestLapTime FROM results AS T1 INNER JOIN drivers AS T2 on T1.driverId = T2.driverId WHERE T1.fastestLapTime IS NOT NULL ORDER BY T1.fastestLapTime ASC LIMIT 1

b.request: Find the driver whose non-missing `results.fastestLapTime` is the shortest across all races, and return their forename and surname
b.sql: SELECT d.forename, d.surname FROM results AS r JOIN drivers AS d ON d.driverId = r.driverId WHERE r.fastestLapTime IS NOT NULL AND instr(r.fastestLapTime, ':') > 0 ORDER BY CAST(substr(r.fastestLapTime, 1, instr(r.fastestLapTime, ':') - 1) AS INTEGER) * 60 + CAST(substr(r.fastestLapTime, instr(r.fastestLapTime, ':') + 1) AS REAL) LIMIT 1;

c.request:
Which driver has the fastest lap time? Please give their forenames and surnames.
Ignore rows where fastestLapTime is missing.
c.sql: SELECT d.forename, d.surname FROM results AS r JOIN drivers AS d ON d.driverId = r.driverId WHERE r.fastestLapTime IS NOT NULL AND r.fastestLapTime <> '' ORDER BY CAST(substr(r.fastestLapTime, 1, instr(r.fastestLapTime, ':') - 1) AS INTEGER) * 60 + CAST(substr(r.fastestLapTime, instr(r.fastestLapTime, ':') + 1) AS REAL) LIMIT 1;

d.request: Which driver has the fastest lap time among rows where `fastestLapTime` is present? Give their forename and surname.
d.sql: SELECT d.forename, d.surname FROM results AS r JOIN drivers AS d ON d.driverId = r.driverId WHERE r.fastestLapTime IS NOT NULL AND r.fastestLapTime <> '' AND instr(r.fastestLapTime, ':') > 0 ORDER BY CAST(substr(r.fastestLapTime, 1, instr(r.fastestLapTime, ':') - 1) AS INTEGER) * 60 + CAST(substr(r.fastestLapTime, instr(r.fastestLapTime, ':') + 1) AS REAL) LIMIT 1
